name: How does AEO identify the best keywords for a family law attorney's website?

mainEntity.name: How does AEO identify the best keywords for a family law attorney's website?

acceptedAnswer.text: AEO uses AI-driven tools to analyze vast amounts of search data, identifying not just popular keywords but also long-tail phrases and semantic variations that indicate high user intent for family law services. It assesses competitor keyword strategies, analyzes local search queries, and identifies emerging trends to select keywords that are most likely to attract qualified leads who are actively seeking specific legal solutions like divorce mediation or child support modification.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO uses AI to analyze search data, competitor strategies, and local queries to identify high-intent keywords and phrases for family law attorneys.
